## Type of Change

- [ ] FEAT: new functionality
- [ ] REFACTOR: code change with no behavior change (neither bug-fix nor feature)
- [ ] FIX: bug fix
- [ ] PERF: performance improvement
- [ ] BUILD: build system / dependency / CI changes

## Verification Results

### Manual Verification

- [ ] `go test ./...` (or the module's test runner) passes locally
- [ ] Verified on real hardware / rig
- [ ] Verified via emulation / mocks (state what was emulated if hardware wasn't available)
- [ ] Screenshot/video

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits specification (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Documentation updated (module README / ARCHITECTURE.md / ADR for architectural changes)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private IPs/keys included
- [ ] Linear history maintained (squash-merge, no stray merge commits)
- [ ] No direct edits to `main`
